response.text:
**Metric:** Total revenue (annual, 10-K).

**Result:** NVIDIA Corp FY2023 (fiscal year ended January 29, 2023) revenue = $26,974,000,000 (~$26.97 billion), up from $26,914,000,000 in the prior fiscal year ended January 30, 2022 — an increase of ~$60 million (≈0.2%). No adjustment was needed; the reported figure is the target metric as a "direct" kind.

**Evidence:**
- FY2023: XBRL concept `us-gaap:Revenues`, accession 0001045810-23-000017, CIK 1045810, filed 2023-02-24, period 2022-01-31 → 2023-01-29, unit USD — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581023000017/0001045810-23-000017-index.htm
- FY2022 (comparison): XBRL concept `us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax`, accession 0001045810-22-000036, filed 2022-03-18 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581022000036/0001045810-22-000036-index.htm

Both the frozen evidence and the tool lookup agree on the same accession, concept, period and value.

ANSWER: $26,974,000,000 (USD, FY2023 revenue)
